reviewList.title: Perfect summer getaway with friends
reviewList.text: Spacious layout, beautiful pool, and very responsive host. Blender was a bit leaky when making smoothies, but everything else was 5-star quality. Highly recommend!

managementResponse.text: Thank you Rachel! We've replaced the blender pitcher and gasket. Hope to see you again next summer!
